From north to south it is 1752 kilometres.
sentences.Litt sør for Narvik er landet bare 6 kil: A little south of Narvik the country is only 6 kilometres wide.
sentences.Det er mange øyer, fjorder og fjell her: There are many islands, fjords and mountains in this country, and there are also large forests.
sentences.Faktisk er cirka 25 % av Norge skog. Bar: In fact, about 25% of Norway is forest. Only 3% is farmland.
sentences.Naturen er vakker mange steder, kanskje: The scenery is beautiful in many places, perhaps especially in Vestlandet and in Northern Norway, and many tourists come here to experience nature.
sentences.På Vestlandet er det høye, bratte fjell: In Vestlandet there are high, steep mountains and many long fjords.
One of these fjords is the Sognefjord.
sentences.Den er 200 kilometer lang og 1300 meter: It is 200 kilometres long and 1300 metres deep.
In Northern Norway you can see the midnight sun.
sentences.Om sommeren er det lyst både natt og dag: In summer it is light both night and day, and in fine weather you can see the sun in the middle of the night.
sentences.Langs sørlandskysten er det ikke så høye: Along the south coast the mountains aren't so high, but there are loads of islands and small fjords.
White wooden houses line the coast.
sentences.Det er populært å ha hytte på Sørlandet: It's popular to have a cabin in Sørlandet and spend the summer holidays there.
sentences.Det er også populært å ha hytte på fjell: It's also popular to have a cabin in the mountains.
sentences.Der kan folk være i feriene både om somm: People can stay there during the holidays both in summer and in winter.
sentences.Hvor velger folk å bo i Norge?: Where do people choose to live in Norway?
sentences.9 av 10 bor ved kysten, og mange har fly: 9 out of 10 live on the coast, and many have moved from small places to built-up areas (that is, places with more than 200 people).
sentences.I dag bor 3 av 4 nordmenn i en by eller: Today 3 out of 4 Norwegians live in a town or a built-up area.
sentences.Halvparten av landets befolkning bor på: Half of the country's population lives in Østlandet, and that's also where Oslo, the capital of the country, is.
